description: This Java source file defines the SslAcceleratorValve class, a custom Tomcat Valve used to mark requests as secure based on a specified SSL accelerator port. It includes methods for setting and getting the SSL accelerator port and overrides the invoke method to modify request security attributes.

classes.name: SslAcceleratorValve
classes.description: A custom Tomcat Valve that marks the request as secure if it arrives on a specified SSL accelerator port.

methods.name: setSslAcceleratorPort
methods.description: Sets the SSL accelerator port used to determine if a request should be marked as secure.

methods.name: getSslAcceleratorPort
methods.description: Retrieves the configured SSL accelerator port.

methods.name: invoke
methods.description: Overrides the ValveBase.invoke method to mark the request as secure if it arrives on the specified SSL accelerator port, then forwards the request to the next valve.
